notes:
Quotes normalize PDF/HTML line breaks. No statistics were converted. No explicit authors’ replication-success verdict established for this specific ancillary test. Original primary full text unavailable after DOI landing page (abstract/access only), OpenAlex (no OA location), Unpaywall (no OA location), and targeted open-access searches including author institutional routes. Replication-table original statistics were not substituted.
Source follow-up: Source version: published Journal of Consumer Research article, pp. 223–238, supplied licensed EBSCO PDF with JSTOR provenance footer; title and DOI match. Frozen supplied text used. Text extraction encodes equals as p, less-than as !, and minus as ⫺; numeric values preserve printed precision and mathematical signs are transcribed. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. The paper jointly reports both main effects only as F values < 1; neither an individual exact F nor a p value is printed. No p value derived.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Both named ANOVA main effects are explicitly reported together as F values < 1. Retained the printed F bound; no exact statistic inferred.
